title: Position Based Dynamics
abstract: Simulation of deformable objects is an important part of computer games and movie effects. We present Position Based Dynamics, a method which computes positions directly to avoid the numerical instability of explicit integration schemes and the damping of implicit integration.

title: A Survey of Software Refactoring
abstract: Refactoring is the process of changing a software system in such a way that it does not alter the external behavior of the code yet improves its internal structure. This paper provides an extensive survey of software refactoring techniques, tool support, empirical studies, and code smell detection.

title: Visual Object Tracking with Discriminative Correlation Filters
abstract: Visual object tracking is a fundamental computer vision problem. We investigate correlation filters learned on multi-channel feature maps for real-time tracking, integrating spatial regularization to mitigate boundary effects in visual tracking benchmarks.

title: Software-Defined Networking: A Comprehensive Survey
abstract: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) is an emerging paradigm that decouples the network control plane from the data forwarding plane. We survey SDN architectural models, OpenFlow protocol standards, switch virtualization, controller platforms, and network slicing.

title: Energy-Efficient Collaborative Sensing in Mobile Edge Clouds
abstract: Mobile devices face stringent energy limitations when continuously harvesting sensor data. We propose an energy-aware scheduling algorithm for mobile edge computing networks that dynamically distributes mobile sensing workloads across opportunistic wireless nodes.

title: Cloud Computing and Emerging Internet Technologies: A Survey
abstract: Distributed systems have evolved towards scalable cloud computing architectures, serverless computing, and fog-edge infrastructures. This article explores resource allocation algorithms, container orchestration, and workflow scheduling for big data analytics.

title: D3: Data-Driven Documents
abstract: Information visualization on the Web requires expressive and efficient representations. We introduce D3, a JavaScript library that binds arbitrary data to a Document Object Model, enabling direct manipulation of visual elements and smooth transitions without a proprietary framework.
true_journal_title: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics

title: An Empirical Study of Code Review Quality and Developer Experience
abstract: Code review is widely adopted to ensure software quality and spread domain knowledge. We conduct an empirical investigation across thousands of pull requests to measure the relationship between reviewer experience, review turnaround time, and post-release defect density.

title: Adaptive Query Processing for Distributed Relational Databases
abstract: Query optimization in distributed relational database engines often suffers from stale cardinality estimates. We develop adaptive query processing techniques that monitor operator pipelines at runtime, dynamically reordering joins and swapping index scan operators.

title: Hardware-Assisted Memory Isolation and Control Flow Integrity
abstract: Memory safety vulnerabilities remain a primary exploit vector in systems software. We present a compiler and architectural co-design that enforces forward-edge and backward-edge control flow integrity using pointer authentication and hardware shadow stacks.
true_journal_title: IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing

title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Autonomous Driving Sensor Fusion
abstract: Autonomous perception requires robust integration of LiDAR point clouds, radar echoes, and multi-camera RGB streams. We propose a cross-attention multimodal fusion network that aligns heterogeneous sensor streams under adverse weather conditions.

title: Scale-Invariant Feature Detection and Visual Landmark Recognition
abstract: Image matching across varying viewpoints and lighting conditions demands invariant local descriptors. We develop a scale-space extrema detection algorithm using difference-of-Gaussians, extracting local gradient orientation histograms for 3D visual reconstruction.

title: PAC-Bayesian Bounds for Reinforcement Learning in Markov Decision Processes
abstract: Generalization bounds in reinforcement learning guarantee policy performance under distribution shift. We derive PAC-Bayesian concentration inequalities for model-based Markov decision processes with continuous state representations.

title: Neural Collaborative Filtering with Graph Attention Networks
abstract: Recommender systems depend on modeling user-item interactions and high-order collaborative signals. We introduce a graph neural network architecture that propagates user preference embeddings through bipartite interaction graphs with attention weights.

title: Microservice Architecture Decomposition and Anti-pattern Detection
abstract: Decomposing monolithic applications into independently deployable microservices introduces architectural challenges. We propose a metric-driven method to identify microservice anti-patterns such as cyclic dependencies and nanaservices from distributed tracing logs.

title: Scalable Graph Analytics and Subgraph Isomorphism Algorithms
abstract: Analyzing massive graph topologies in social and biological networks requires efficient subgraph matching. We propose a parallel backtracking algorithm with adaptive filtering and candidate ordering to accelerate exact subgraph isomorphism search.

title: Social Capital and Algorithmic Curation on Social Networking Platforms
abstract: This study investigates how algorithmic feed curation shapes user social capital, interpersonal trust, and digital engagement. Using a longitudinal panel survey of young adults, we analyze communicative norms and network effects in mediated environments.

title: Near-Memory Computing Architectures for Energy-Efficient Matrix Multiplication
abstract: Data movement between DRAM and processing units dominates energy consumption in data-intensive workloads. We propose a domain-specific 3D-stacked memory architecture that executes systolic GEMM operations directly inside the memory logic die.

title: Automated Program Repair Using Pre-trained Code Models and Test Feedback
abstract: Automated patch generation aims to fix software defects without human intervention. We present a neural program repair framework that combines large language models trained on source code with symbolic execution and regression test validation.

title: Real-Time Path Tracing with Spatiotemporal Reservoir Resampling
abstract: Rendering complex scenes with dynamic many-light illumination at interactive frame rates requires efficient Monte Carlo sampling. We extend spatiotemporal reservoir resampling to reuse visibility and irradiance samples across consecutive video frames.
